questions.label: MCQ1
questions.question:
A ball is thrown vertically upwards from the ground. Ignore air resistance. Which ONE of the following graphs best represents the acceleration versus time graph for the motion of the ball from the moment it is thrown until it returns to the ground?

A A straight horizontal line at a positive value.
B A straight horizontal line at a negative value.
C A straight line with a positive gradient.
D A straight line with a negative gradient.

(2)

questions.label: MCQ2
questions.question:
A stone is dropped from rest from the top of a tall building. Ignore air resistance. Which ONE of the following statements is CORRECT about the motion of the stone?

A The velocity of the stone decreases.
B The acceleration of the stone increases.
C The acceleration of the stone remains constant.
D The displacement of the stone decreases.

(2)

questions.label: MCQ3
questions.question:
A hot-air balloon is moving downwards at a constant velocity. A small stone is dropped from the balloon. Ignore the effects of friction on the stone. Which ONE of the following graphs represents the motions of the balloon and the stone?

A The balloon and stone have the same velocity-time graph.
B The balloon has a constant negative velocity and the stone has a constant positive velocity.
C The balloon has a constant negative velocity and the stone has a velocity that increases in the negative direction.
D The balloon has a constant negative velocity and the stone has a velocity that decreases in the negative direction.

(2)

questions.label: MCQ4
questions.question:
A ball is thrown vertically upwards from the top of a building. It rises to a maximum height and then falls to the ground below. Ignore air resistance. Which ONE of the following graphs best represents the velocity versus time graph for the motion of the ball?

A A straight line with a positive gradient, crossing the time axis once.
B A straight line with a negative gradient, crossing the time axis once.
C A straight line with a positive gradient, crossing the time axis twice.
D A straight line with a negative gradient, crossing the time axis twice.

(2)

questions.label: MCQ5

Two identical balls, A and B, are thrown vertically upwards from the same point at the same time. Ball A is thrown with an initial velocity of 10 m/s and ball B with an initial velocity of 20 m/s. Ignore air resistance. Which ONE of the following statements is CORRECT?

A Ball A reaches a greater maximum height than ball B.
B Both balls reach the same maximum height.
C Ball B reaches a greater maximum height than ball A.
D Ball A takes longer to reach its maximum height than ball B.

(2)
